summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespaces in rdflib/namespace.py and added tests in test/test_namespace.py. Namespace.__contains__ returns ref.startswith(self) (prefix test, reference as receiver). ClosedNamespace.__contains__ returns any(ref == uri for uri in self.__uris.values()), so only stored term URIs are members and _RDFNamespace inherits it; container properties like rdf _1 are not members. The closed-namespace _ipython_key_completions_ now returns dir(str(self.uri)). New tests in NamespacePrefixTest cover prefix positive/self/proper-prefix cases, RDFS positive/undefined/plain-string/Literal cases, and RDF rdf:type positive plus rdf _1 negative. Tests and doctests were not run, per instructions. Nothing committed.
